newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EA-Generali sees slowdown in earnings.
newsitem.headline: EA-Generali sees slowdown in earnings.

text.p: Austrian insurer EA-Generali said on Thursday it expected earnings growth in the current year to ease amid a slowdown in its life insurance business.

"We can't assume that the developments of earnings will continue this year as it did in 1996," chief executive Dietrich Karner told a news conference shortly after the group reported a 25 percent increase in net profit to 600 million schillings.
Last year's gain in earnings was driven by a strong increase in life insurance income, as Austrians scrambled to buy policies before a tax change came into effect in May 1996.
In Austria, EA-Generali reported a 61 percent jump in life insurance premiums. Total group premiums were up at 42.7 billion schillings, from 36.88 billion a year earlier, the group said.
